---

## Purpose & Context
Delivering a tightly timed 75-minute workshop with an external 15-minute operational buffer requires rigid timekeeping between the lead facilitator, co-presenters, and roaming technical assistants. The run sheet serves as the minute-by-minute operational clock for the event.

---

## Exact Scope
### In Scope
- Finalize the operational schedule across setup (30m), core delivery (75m), floating buffer (15m), and post-event debrief (15m).
- Define explicit responsibility handoffs between lead presenter and roaming TAs during each segment.
- Establish the **Buffer Deployment Protocol**: specify under what exact conditions the 15-minute buffer is triggered (e.g. Wi-Fi outage, >20% room experiencing compilation errors).

### Out of Scope
- Altering the 8 core instructional segments or altering segment durations.

---

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Confirms exact segment boundaries: 0–5m, 5–12m, 12–25m, 25–43m, 43–48m, 48–53m, 53–71m, 71–75m.
- [ ] Details explicit roles for Lead Speaker, Roaming TAs, and Timekeeper.
- [ ] Contains objective trigger criteria for deploying the 15-minute floating buffer.
- [ ] Incorporates post-event feedback collection mechanism.
